{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; noted potential confusion around non-global options and suggested #30342 could land first"
    },
    {
      "login": "stringintech",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "prefers waiting for #30342 so API signatures do not falsely suggest per-connection isolation while options remain global"
    },
    {
      "login": "stickies-v",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK on local interface but approach ~0 leaning NACK, preferring draft discussion while internal refactorings like #30342 land; resolved earlier lifetime concerns"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:3529907874",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "Accepting per-connection handles on logging configuration functions suggests per-connection isolation while calling them still overrides settings globally across all connections",
      "quote": "keep the API consistent with what it's currently capable of",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3530425864",
        "c:3533008173"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3532938522",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "Exposing a new public interface before internal logging refactorings like #30342 proceed risks unexpected behavior and misses insights that internal changes could provide for interface design",
      "quote": "internal logging refactorings / changes (e.g. #30342, but also others) may surface roadblocks or ideas that inform us about a better interface design, so waiting a bit more seems helpful to me",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3533073827"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2606640746",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "If context does not own the logging connection, object lifetime management becomes brittle and destroying a logging connection could leave the associated context in an invalid state",
      "quote": "managing lifetimes becomes more brittle, i.e. users must ensure `logger` is kept alive for the duration of `context`",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2606882104",
        "rc:2607212025",
        "rc:2607868168"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2607414440",
      "settled_by_quote": "I agree then that there is no need for context to own the logging connection."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:3517090033",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "This is close to how I hoped to implement the logging capabilities",
      "substantive": true
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3532938522",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "making the logging interface local instead of global",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial assessment. Both stringintech and stickies-v prefer waiting for internal per-instance logging in #30342 before changing the public kernel logging API, while stickies-v's concerns regarding logger ownership and context lifetime were clarified and resolved in discussion."
}
